Use grep/find extensively - search for terms like: "go func", "cron", "ticker", "NewTicker", "scheduler", "Start(", "worker", "background", "interval", "AfterFunc", "goroutine".

Also check if this is a Go project (likely, given "memos" - it's the open source Memos note-taking app). Look at the main server struct/file (likely server/server.go or similar) and its Start method.

Report back: a list of "runner name — trigger mechanism" pairs, citing file paths and line numbers. Also explicitly note any scheduling infra that's present in the code but never started/called by the server.
